line: Life learned in that order too. English Nobel scientist Sherrington wrote that in living things, MUSCLE comes before nerve, "and nerve is there before mind". Mind arrived last.
credit: SIR CHARLES SHERRINGTON · MAN ON HIS NATURE · 1940
